name: omatic-project-bot
description: Project Bot and specialist workflows for o-MATIC factories; requires an authorized o-MATIC Server connection.

interface.longDescription: The o-MATIC Project Bot starts and verifies your selected factory, then routes work to its specialist crew through your authenticated o-MATIC Server. It owns the request end to end while respecting the host's actual tools, grants, and orchestration capabilities.
capabilities: Coordinate a factory request from plan through verification
Use connected o-MATIC Server tools when authenticated and authorized
Route work to specialist role skills where supported
interface.prompt: Start the o-MATIC factory and report the live checks and available specialists.
